name: Entry Speed and Braking Distance Bidirectional Coupling
description: Train entry speed and braking distance are bidirectionally coupled through wheel-rail adhesion: higher speed requires longer braking distance, and adhesion uncertainty affects both simultaneously. Identity-bidir UPR.

elements.name: Wheel-Rail Adhesion Coefficient
elements.description: Wheel-rail adhesion coefficient under wet/contaminated rail conditions.

uncertainty.source: ERA/TD/2013-015: adhesion coefficient distribution for wet rail conditions

elements.name: Minimum Required Adhesion
elements.description: ERA: minimum adhesion coefficient for guaranteed braking performance
